# Patient RX System v3.3.0

RX Softphone and Call Center integration release.

## Included

- Native RX Softphone dialing, ringing, answer, hangup, timing, SIP outcome, and automatic Called reporting.
- Outbound Windows relay for Kasm and remote-browser sessions.
- Per-user encrypted SIP account setup authorized through Administration > Users.
- Live claim/cooldown/connected timers, shared call state, and detailed Call Attempts analytics.
- Clinic/location and patient transport details in the Call Center roster.
- First-party RX Softphone source under `rx-softphone-desktop`, with a repeatable Windows release builder.
- Remote workstation installation, shared-extension testing, and server preparation runbook at `docs/RX_SOFTPHONE_REMOTE_TESTING.md`.

Use RX Softphone `0.4.1` or later. Review `RELEASE_NOTES-v3.3.0.md` and `PRODUCTION_RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md` before deployment.
